keycps.config.title: KeyCPS Settings
keycps.config.enabled.tooltip: Show or hide the whole overlay.
keycps.config.scale.tooltip: How big the HUD is drawn.
keycps.config.movement.tooltip: Show the W, A, S and D keys.
keycps.config.jump.tooltip: Show the jump key as a bar.
keycps.config.mouse.tooltip: Show the attack and use buttons.
keycps.config.cps.tooltip: Show clicks per second inside the attack and use buttons.
keycps.config.sneak_sprint.tooltip: Show a row with your sneak and sprint keys.
keycps.config.key_rates.tooltip: Show how often each movement key fires per second. Holding a key counts the keyboard repeat rate.
keycps.config.cps_warn.tooltip: The CPS counter turns red at this many clicks per second.
keycps.config.background.tooltip: Draw a box behind each key.
keycps.config.bg_opacity.tooltip: How see-through the key boxes are.
keycps.config.rounded.tooltip: Cut the corners of each key.
keycps.config.shadow.tooltip: Draw a shadow under the text.
keycps.config.fade.tooltip: Fade keys smoothly in and out when pressed.
keycps.config.rainbow.tooltip: Cycle the text through the rainbow.
keycps.config.mouse_labels.tooltip: Label the attack and use keys LMB and RMB even when they're bound to keyboard keys. The CPS still counts those keys, key repeat included.
keycps.config.move.tooltip: Drag the HUD anywhere. It snaps to the edges and centre.
keycps.move.title: Move HUD
keycps.move.hint: Drag the HUD • Esc to save
keycps.welcome: [KeyCPS] Press %s to customise the HUD (or use Mod Menu).
